body:
Review read of head `12c6d0805` (read-only Opus agent that did not write the change, nothing built). **Result: clean, no blocker.** The review comment with the marker follows after the independent run, which is in progress.

- **The two twins are the same algorithm.** `march.rs` and `trace.wgsl` have the same constants (`MAX_STEPS` 256, `BISECT` 6) and the same steps in the same order: a NaN gives no verdict; a last sample in the stock is a hit; if not, one sample one cell further along the ray; if that one is not in the stock there is no verdict; then six halvings, and the hit is on the material side. The loop bounds in WGSL are constants. The texel index is clamped on the GPU; the CPU twin adds no index math.
- **See-through stays exact.** The two extra samples are on the ray. A ray is painted only when the field is negative at a point on that ray, which is the proof of material of the main hit law. A ray that passes near a corner and does not go in keeps "no verdict".
- **Pictures that resolved before do not change.** The loop body, `STEP_EPS`, `RELAX` and the creep step are the same. Only rays that ran out change.
- **The test.** The "sure miss" check uses the box grown by one cell on each side, so "no miss is painted" is a strict guard. The test fails with 64 steps (70 rays at 5 degrees).
- **Rules.** `march.rs` 316 lines, `trace.wgsl` 249, `stock_preview.rs` 393. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` in the new code. No snapshot, no dependency. Decision file, `Changelog:`, `Fixes #3612`: present.
- `main` is not an ancestor of this head; `git merge-tree` with main `8c6b77f94` is clean, and main changed none of these files.

Notes, none is a blocker: the GPU time at low angles was not measured (follow-up filed, with one cell of slack for the "sure hit" box of the pin). No application window was opened, so the picture of the reporter is not reproduced on a screen; he checks on `main` after the merge.

**Review of head `12c6d0805`: clean. No blocker.** The read is in the comment above (a read-only Opus agent that did not write the change). A gate-runner that did not write the change ran a merge of this head with main `8c6b77f94` (merge `3163dcfc3`, not pushed, clean).

- `camcraft-sim` `stock_preview`: 12 passed, with `a_grazing_faced_floor_resolves_and_stays_see_through`.
- **The pin can fail:** with the step cap set to 64 again, that test fails ("10 deg: rays ran out of march steps", 2 rays).
- `camcraft-sim`, whole crate: 857 passed, 0 failed.
- The GPU binaries, with `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1`, one at a time, on a real adapter: `trace_parity` 5 passed, `trace_composite` 5 passed, `gpu_render` 19 passed (1 ignored: the release-lane picture).
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1516 passed, 0 failed.
- clippy with `-D warnings` on `camcraft-sim` and `camcraft-ui`: clean.

Not done: no application window was opened, so the picture of the reporter was not reproduced on a screen; the GPU time at low angles was not measured (#3677). No heavy lane ran (`P3`: none is due).
